articles.title: Psychology explains why first impressions are so powerful - and so difficult to change
articles.description: Our brains form quick judgments about people within milliseconds. Confirmation bias reinforces these initial opinions, making them hard to change. The halo effect allows one positive trait to suggest many others. These mental shortcuts save time but can lead to inaccurate beliefs. Conscious effort and open-mindedness help overcome these ingrained first impressions.
